name: fn_add_numbers
description: Add two numbers together and return their sum.

name: fn_multiply_numbers
description: Multiply two numbers and return the product.

name: fn_power
description: Raise a base number to an integer exponent.

name: fn_is_even
description: Check whether an integer is even.

name: fn_repeat_string
description: Repeat a string a given number of times.

name: fn_reverse
description: Reverse the characters of a string.

name: fn_reverse_words
description: Reverse the order of the words in a sentence.

name: fn_get_weather
description: Get the current weather for a city, in Celsius or Fahrenheit.

name: fn_send_email
description: Send an email to a recipient with a subject and a body.

name: fn_set_alarm
description: Set an alarm at a given hour and minute, optionally repeating every day.

name: fn_count_characters
description: Count how many characters a text contains.
